mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poem_favorite (user_id, poem_id, favorite_type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{poemId}, #{favoriteType})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM poem_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND poem_id = #{poemId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.poem_id, p.title, pt.name AS poet_name, p.creation_year AS create_year, p.poem_form AS form, IFNULL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1) FROM poem_rating r WHERE r.poem_id = p.poem_id), 0) AS avg_score, f.favorite_type, f.favorited_at AS favorite_time FROM poem_favorite f JOIN poem p ON p.poem_id = f.poem_id JOIN poet pt ON pt.poet_id = p.poet_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND p.publication_status = 'published' ORDER BY f.favorited_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poem_favorite f JOIN poem p ON p.poem_id = f.poem_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND p.publication_status = 'published'
